shared_widgets.name: PulseAppBar
shared_widgets.description: Branded AppBar showing PulsePhones wordmark/title, optional cart IconButton with quantity badge (min 48dp touch target), semantic label PulsePhones storefront. Uses brandPrimary/appBar tokens; back chevron on detail/cart.

shared_widgets.name: ProductListTile
shared_widgets.description: List row for a smartphone: 72dp image/placeholder, product name (titleMedium), USD price from integer cents via PriceText (priceMedium), StarRatingSummary. Min height 72dp; entire tile Semantics button with label including name, price, and rating. Tap navigates to /products/:id.

shared_widgets.name: ProductImagePlaceholder
shared_widgets.description: Aspect-ratio box (1:1 list, 4:3 detail) with imagePlaceholder fill, optional phone silhouette Icon, Semantics image label Product image for {name} or Placeholder image for {name}.

shared_widgets.name: PriceText
shared_widgets.description: Formats integer USD minor units (cents) plus ISO 4217 USD to locale display e.g. $899.99 for 89999. Never accepts float storage; uses price color token and priceMedium/priceLarge styles.

shared_widgets.name: StarRatingSummary
shared_widgets.description: Row of 5 stars (filled/half/empty via ratingStar tokens) plus numeric average (e.g. 4.5) in labelMedium/textSecondary. Semantics label Rated {n} out of 5 stars. Touch targets not required when display-only.

shared_widgets.name: PrimaryButton
shared_widgets.description: Filled button min height 48dp, brandPrimary fill, onPrimary label (labelLarge). Used for Add to cart. Semantics button with explicit action label.

shared_widgets.name: QuantityStepper
shared_widgets.description: Row of decrease IconButton, quantity Text (titleMedium), increase IconButton; each control min 48dp. Decrease at qty 1 becomes remove or disables per cart rules. Semantics labels Decrease quantity, Increase quantity, Quantity {n}.

shared_widgets.name: AsyncStateView
shared_widgets.description: Reusable loading (CircularProgressIndicator + Loading catalog), empty (illustration + message + optional retry), error (error color message + Retry PrimaryButton). Used by list/detail/cart AsyncValue branches.

shared_widgets.name: CartLineItem
shared_widgets.description: Cart row: product name, PriceText unit snapshot (cents+USD), QuantityStepper, remove IconButton (48dp). Semantics summarize name, unit price, quantity.

shared_widgets.name: SectionHeader
shared_widgets.description: titleLarge section title for Key details on detail screen; textPrimary; padding from spacing scale.

screens.name: ProductListScreen
screens.purpose: PulsePhones-branded scrollable browse of 12–20 seeded smartphones showing name, USD price from integer cents, star rating summary, and image/placeholder so shoppers can compare models and open a product. Initial route and demo home; no network or auth.

screens.name: ProductDetailScreen
screens.purpose: Shows one seeded smartphone: name, USD price from integer cents (e.g. $899.99 for 89999), key details/specs, star rating, image/placeholder; optional Add to cart for in-memory cart. Back returns to list without losing local catalog state.

screens.name: CartScreen
screens.purpose: Optional M1 in-memory cart: line items with product name, unit price snapshot (cents + USD), quantity increase/decrease/remove. Session-only; empty after process kill. No persistence, auth, or payments.

navigation.trigger: Tap ProductListTile for product id → go_router push /products/:id
AppBar back / system back → pop to /products; CatalogRepository state retained
After Add to cart (or AppBar cart icon) → go /cart showing new line qty 1
AppBar cart IconButton when badge > 0 → go /cart
AppBar back / Continue browsing → pop or go /products
Optional tap CartLineItem name → push /products/:id for that product

accessibility: Minimum touch target 48dp for ProductListTile actions, AppBar icons, PrimaryButton, QuantityStepper, Retry, Remove.
WCAG AA contrast: textPrimary on background/surface ≥ 4.5:1; onPrimary on brandPrimary ≥ 4.5:1; price and body text meet AA in light and dark.
Semantics labels on all images/icons: product images, star icons, cart badge, back, add/remove/stepper.
ProductListTile Semantics button: {name}, {formatted price}, rated {n} out of 5.
Announce AsyncStateView loading/empty/error via Semantics liveRegion or AnnounceSemantics where practical.
Do not rely on color alone for rating or error; pair with text/icons.
Support system text scaling; avoid clipping primary prices and titles at 1.3x scale.
Focus order: AppBar → list/content → primary CTA (Add to cart / Retry).
English USD-only M1 copy; prices always formatted from integer cents, never spoken as raw float storage values.
